defect.summary: Under a token cap, gstack-review-log --start treated any marker pointing at a stopped run, or at a ledger file that no longer exists, as an active capped run. After such a run, every later uncapped review start on the branch refused with exit 1 instead of simply capturing.

severity.basis: The fix adds a regression test ('a stopped run or a lost ledger does not block a later uncapped review on the branch') that the old activeLedger/admitReviewStart code fails, and the PR body describes every later uncapped start exiting 1, which breaks the review workflow.
